_note: Captain traits. Effects are read by sim code by key.

greedy.name: Greedy
greedy.text: More loot; loyalty drops fast when unpaid.

brave.name: Brave
brave.text: Hits harder, but risks his neck.

cautious.name: Cautious
cautious.text: His band takes fewer losses when it routs.

schemer.name: Schemer
schemer.text: +15 Cunning for sham battles; less loyal.

beloved.name: Beloved
beloved.text: His band never deserts while he lives.

drunkard.name: Drunkard
drunkard.text: Slow to react in battle; cheap to keep.

vainglorious.name: Vainglorious
vainglorious.text: Loves a famous victory; sulks after a defeat.
